lists.text: No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:
lists.content:
• Go onsite and meet with customer analysts to understand the critical questions they need to answer and locate their biggest struggles.
  • Build a case for gaining access to the relevant datasets, and work with Forward Deployed Engineers to integrate the data into a stable and extensible pipeline.
  • Create and lead training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting the needs of a range of users, and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our partners' operations.
  • Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from analysts to C-suite executives.
  • Embed with our Software Engineering and Product Design teams to incorporate what you saw in the field into cross-Palantir product offerings.
  • Build and deliver demos to new and existing customers.
  • Scope out potential engagements in new industries and in increasingly expanding locations around the world.

• Extraordinary ability to take on open-ended problems in unstructured environments.
  • Ability to be adaptive and introspective; willingness to learn, teach, lead and follow.
  • Ability to travel as needed. Varies by location and team.
  • Experience with programming, scripting or statistical packages (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, SQL) is a plus.
• Active US Security clearance or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance.

lists.content:
• Provide administrative support to a portfolio of individuals/teams across the business.
  • Handle sophisticated calendars in a fast-paced environment, and prioritize commitments to enhance time and productivity.
  • Book travel arrangements (domestic and international).
  • Track and process expense reports.
  • Help plan, support, and complete office events and external gatherings.
  • Work both autonomously and in collaboration with teammates, colleagues, and external contacts.

• Ability to adjust quickly, anticipate needs, and implement autonomously, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to interact with a wide range of teams internally and externally with thoughtfulness and tact.
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and discretion in both internal and external interactions.

• At least three years of previous administrative or personal support experience, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent digital literacy, including proficiency with Microsoft products (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).
  • Experience with scheduling sophisticated international and domestic travel itineraries.
  • Familiarity with travel booking and expense reporting software.

lists.content:
• Provide administrative and operational support to leaders and teams within Palantir’s Security function.
  • Support Security team programs, including onboarding, internal events, offsites, people processes, awareness campaigns, training rollouts, and recurring communications.
  • Manage complex calendars, meeting preparation, travel, expenses, budgets and internal operating cadences.
  • Handle sensitive communications, materials, and operational details with excellent judgment, confidentiality, and discretion.
  • Identify operational problems, diagnose root causes, and drive solutions to completion.
  • Partner with teammates, stakeholders, and engineering counterparts to identify, configure, and improve AI-enabled workflows for repeatable coordination tasks.
  • Work autonomously while adapting quickly as team needs, tools, and operating systems evolve.

• Exceptional organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.
  • Strong judgment, integrity, and discretion, especially when handling confidential, restricted, or sensitive information.
  • Ability to anticipate needs, identify gaps, and act autonomously without waiting for direction.
  • A high sense of urgency and the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong interpersonal instincts and the ability to work thoughtfully with senior leaders, cross-functional partners, external contacts, and teammates.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and adapting as systems, priorities, and team needs evolve.
  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational leverage.
  • Willingness to learn about information security concepts, priorities, and operating models.

• 2+ years of previous administrative or executive support experience, preferably in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience managing complex calendars, competing priorities, and time-sensitive requests.
  • Experience handling confidential or sensitive information with discretion.
  • Experience with domestic and international travel coordination.
  • Strong written communication skills and comfort preparing materials, summaries, communications, or reports.
  • Interest in using AI tools, agents, or automation to improve operational workflows; prior experience with AI-enabled tools is helpful but not required.
